encounter.notes: Large bare humanoid of charred black rock split by lava fissures, with glowing yellow eyes and no armour or clothing. The in-game flame VFX is ADDITIVE and drawn on top by the renderer, so the correct input is the plate's base skin - no attempt is made to bake flames into the atlas.

reference.closeup_policy: Deliberately none - 512px trash profile; the base plates carry a 997/993px subject, already ~2x the atlas.
reference.orientation_verified: 2026-09-07, side by side in _advice-crops/fb-pair.jpg: view-01 shows the face with two glowing eyes, the chest and the toes; view-03 shows the back of the skull, the spine and the heels. The cleanest orthographic A-pose pair in the whole trash set.
